description_target.target_text: Order the objects by their top-left corners. Dilate each object by one orthogonal step. Output a square matrix whose diagonal cells are the object colors and whose off-diagonal cells are 8 exactly when the two dilated objects touch.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))

    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (obj< a b)
      (let ((ba (obj-bbox a)) (bb (obj-bbox b)))
        (if (= (first ba) (first bb)) (< (second ba) (second bb)) (< (first ba) (first bb)))))
    (define (nonzero-cells grid)
      (sort (filter (lambda (cell) (not (= (third cell) 0))) (grid-cells grid))
            (lambda (a b) (cell< (list (first a) (second a)) (list (first b) (second b))))))
    (define (points-of grid color)
      (sort (find-color grid color) cell<))
    (define (nonzero-colors grid)
      (grid-colors grid 0))
    (define (bbox-h bb) (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))
    (define (bbox-w bb) (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))
    (define (bbox-area bb) (* (bbox-h bb) (bbox-w bb)))
    (define (bbox-cells bb)
      (positions-in-rect (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)))
    (define (member-cell? p cells)
      (member p cells))
    (define (object-grid obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (h (bbox-h bb))
             (w (bbox-w bb))
             (norm (normalize-cells (obj-cells obj))))
        (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0) norm (obj-color obj))))
    (define (stamp-grid-nonzero out sub tr tc)
      (foldl (lambda (cell acc)
               (let* ((r (+ tr (first cell)))
                      (c (+ tc (second cell)))
                      (v (third cell)))
                 (if (and (not (= v 0)) (in-bounds? r c (rows acc) (cols acc)))
                     (set-cell acc r c v)
                     acc)))
             out
             (grid-cells sub)))
    (define (transform-object-grid sub code)
      (cond [(= code 1) sub]
            [(= code 2) (rotate-cw sub)]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-180 sub)]
            [(= code 4) (flip-lr sub)]
            [else sub]))
    (define (rotate-anchor-grid sub code)
      (cond [(= code 1) sub]
            [(= code 2) (rotate-cw sub)]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-180 sub)]
            [(= code 4) (rotate-ccw sub)]
            [else sub]))
    (define (rect-frame? grid obj)
      (let* ((color (obj-color obj))
             (bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (r1 (first bb)) (c1 (second bb))
             (r2 (third bb)) (c2 (fourth bb))
             (h (bbox-h bb)) (w (bbox-w bb))
             (perim (- (+ (* 2 h) (* 2 w)) 4)))
        (and (>= h 3)
             (>= w 3)
             (= (obj-size obj) perim)
             (all? (lambda (c) (= (at grid r1 c) color)) (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
             (all? (lambda (c) (= (at grid r2 c) color)) (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
             (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c1) color)) (range r1 (+ r2 1)))
             (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c2) color)) (range r1 (+ r2 1))))))
    (define (interior-cells-of-frame obj)
      (let ((bb (obj-bbox obj)))
        (positions-in-rect (+ (first bb) 1) (+ (second bb) 1) (- (third bb) 1) (- (fourth bb) 1))))
    (define (frame-seeds grid obj)
      (let ((wall (obj-color obj)))
        (filter (lambda (p)
                  (let ((v (at grid (first p) (second p))))
                    (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v wall)))))
                (interior-cells-of-frame obj))))
    (define (paint-rect out r1 c1 r2 c2 color)
      (paint-cells out (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2) color))
    (define (line-of-sight-clear? grid a b)
      (let* ((r1 (first a)) (c1 (second a))
             (r2 (first b)) (c2 (second b)))
        (cond [(= r1 r2)
               (all? (lambda (c) (not (= (at grid r1 c) 5)))
                     (range (+ (min c1 c2) 1) (max c1 c2)))]
              [(= c1 c2)
               (all? (lambda (r) (not (= (at grid r c1) 5)))
                     (range (+ (min r1 r2) 1) (max r1 r2)))]
              [else #f])))
    (define (dilated-cells grid obj)
      (remove-duplicates
       (append (obj-cells obj)
               (flatmap (lambda (p)
                          (filter (lambda (q) (in-bounds? (first q) (second q) (rows grid) (cols grid)))
                                  (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))))
                                       cardinal-deltas)))
                        (obj-cells obj)))))
    (define (overlap-cells? a b)
      (any? (lambda (p) (member p b)) a))
    (define (path-between grid start goal)
      (define deltas cardinal-deltas)
      (define parent (make-hash))
      (define seen (make-hash))
      (define found #f)
      (hash-set! seen start #t)
      (let bfs ((queue (list start)))
        (cond [(or found (empty? queue)) #f]
              [else
               (let* ((cur (first queue))
                      (restq (rest queue)))
                 (if (equal? cur goal)
                     (set! found #t)
                     (let ((newq
                            (let add-neighbors ((ds deltas) (acc restq))
                              (if (empty? ds)
                                  acc
                                  (let* ((d (first ds))
                                         (np (list (+ (first cur) (first d)) (+ (second cur) (second d)))))
                                    (if (and (in-bounds? (first np) (second np) (rows grid) (cols grid))
                                             (not (= (at grid (first np) (second np)) 5))
                                             (not (hash-has-key? seen np)))
                                        (begin
                                          (hash-set! seen np #t)
                                          (hash-set! parent np cur)
                                          (add-neighbors (rest ds) (append acc (list np))))
                                        (add-neighbors (rest ds) acc)))))))
                       (bfs newq))))]))
      (if (not found)
          (list start)
          (let reconstruct ((cur goal) (acc (list goal)))
            (if (equal? cur start)
                acc
                (let ((prev (hash-ref parent cur)))
                  (reconstruct prev (cons prev acc)))))))
    (define (first-fitting-frame grid obj indexed-frames used)
      (define og (object-grid obj))
      (define candidates
        (filter (lambda (entry)
                  (let* ((idx (first entry))
                         (frame (second entry))
                         (bb (obj-bbox frame))
                         (ih (- (third bb) (first bb) 1))
                         (iw (- (fourth bb) (second bb) 1))
                         (rot (rotate-cw og))
                         (fits-id (and (<= (rows og) ih) (<= (cols og) iw)))
                         (fits-rot (and (<= (rows rot) ih) (<= (cols rot) iw))))
                    (and (not (member idx used)) (or fits-id fits-rot))))
                indexed-frames))
      (if (empty? candidates)
          #f
          (let* ((scored
                  (map (lambda (entry)
                         (let* ((idx (first entry))
                                (frame (second entry))
                                (bb (obj-bbox frame))
                                (ih (- (third bb) (first bb) 1))
                                (iw (- (fourth bb) (second bb) 1))
                                (rot (rotate-cw og))
                                (fits-id (and (<= (rows og) ih) (<= (cols og) iw)))
                                (fit-grid (if fits-id og rot))
                                (leftover (- (* ih iw) (* (rows fit-grid) (cols fit-grid)))))
                           (list leftover (first bb) (second bb) idx frame fit-grid)))
                       candidates))
                 (best (first (sort scored
                                    (lambda (a b)
                                      (cond [(not (= (first a) (first b))) (< (first a) (first b))]
                                            [(not (= (second a) (second b))) (< (second a) (second b))]
                                            [else (< (third a) (third b))]))))))
            (list (list-ref best 3) (list-ref best 4) (list-ref best 5)))))

    (let* ((objs (sort (objects g 0) obj<))
           (dilated (map (lambda (o) (dilated-cells g o)) objs))
           (n (length objs)))
      (grid-from-fn n n
        (lambda (r c)
          (if (= r c)
              (obj-color (list-ref objs r))
              (if (overlap-cells? (list-ref dilated r) (list-ref dilated c)) 8 0)))))
  ))
